1. Down arrow and S set keys['down'] but nothing reads it, so they never lower the gripper. They must do exactly
   what Space does (lower / drop), triggered once per key press (ignore key auto-repeat via e.repeat).
2. The held object is drawn in the wrong place. drawGripper() translates to the gripper and then calls
   drawObject(holdingObj), but drawObject() itself translates by o.x + o.w/2, o.y + o.h/2 (the object's old belt
   position), so the held object is drawn far from the jaws. Draw it centred between the jaws.

4. Falling objects: dropObject() sets fall.x = gripperX (a centre), but drawObject() and the bin test treat x as

5. Fast drop (Space pressed twice quickly) should visibly lower the gripper faster (e.g. 3x speed); it currently
   only sets a flag. Normal lowering must stay safe for eggs.
6. While the gripper is lowering, the grab check uses only gripperX inside [o.x, o.x+o.w]; widen it by the jaw
   width so grabbing an object under the jaws is not pixel-perfect.
7. Pressing R on the start screen should also start the game (it is swallowed by the start-screen handler).

      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 0.05, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }

    // HUD
    drawHUD();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawObject(o) {
    const cx = o.x + o.w/2, cy = o.y + o.h/2;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[o.color];
    if (o.shape === 'cube') {
      ctx.fillRect(-o.w/2, -o.h/2, o.w, o.h);
    } else if (o.shape === 'cylinder') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, o.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillRect(-o.w/2, -o.h/2, o.w, o.h/2);
    } else if (o.shape === 'egg') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, o.w/2, o.h/2, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawGripper() {
    const jawW = 0.3, jawH = 0.5;
    const open = gripperState === 'up' || gripperState === 'down';
    const gap = open ? 0.15 : 0.02;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(gripperX, gripperY);
    // gantry
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#666';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.05;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-0.5, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(0.5, 0);
    ctx.stroke();
    // jaws
    ctx.fillStyle = '#999';
    // left jaw
    ctx.fillRect(-jawW/2 - gap/2, 0, jawW/2, jawH);
    // right jaw
    ctx.fillRect(gap/2, 0, jawW/2, jawH);
    // if holding, draw object centred between the jaws
    if (holdingObj && (gripperState === 'holding' || gripperState === 'lifting')) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(0, jawH);
      drawObject({ ...holdingObj, x: -holdingObj.w/2, y: 0 });
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = '0.5px Arial';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 0.3, 0.3);
    ctx.fillText('Sorted: ' + sorted + ' / 20', 0.3, 0.8);
    ctx.fillText('Level: ' + level, 0.3, 1.3);
    ctx.fillText('Combo: ' + combo, 0.3, 1.8);
    // lives
    for (let i=0; i<lives; i++) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(2.5 + i*0.4, 2.3, 0.15, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // ---------- start screen ----------
  function showStartScreen() {
    title.textContent = 'Gripper Rush';
    msg.textContent = 'Sort 20 objects into the correct bins before you run out of 3 lives.';
    final.textContent = '';
    best.textContent = 'Best score: ' + bestScore;
    prompt.textContent = 'Press any key or click to start';
    overlay.classList.add('show');
  }
  showStartScreen();

  // ---------- main loop ----------
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
